## gctx create

Create a new account configuration

```
gctx create <account-name> <target> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Create a new account (auto-authenticates)
  gctx create my-account my-project-id

  # Create an account for another provider
  gctx create prod prod-profile --provider aws
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help              help for create
      --provider string   cloud provider: gcp, aws or azure (default "gcp")
```
